description: Defines the UUID class for Bluetooth, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and parsing UUIDs.

classes.name: UUID
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth UUID with methods for validation, comparison, serialization, and parsing.

methods.name: UUID()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing UUID to invalid state.

methods.name: UUID(const uint32_t uuid)
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a 32-bit integer, setting short or full UUID accordingly.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const uint8_t uuid[16])
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a 16-byte array, determining if it contains the base UUID.

methods.name: explicit UUID(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Constructs UUID from a string representation, parsing the UUID string.

methods.name: UUID(const UUID& copy)
methods.description: Copy constructor.

methods.name: ~UUID()
methods.description: Destructor.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator copying UUID data.

methods.name: IsValid()
methods.description: Checks if UUID is valid.

methods.name: Short()
methods.description: Returns the 16-bit short UUID if available.

methods.name: Full()
methods.description: Returns pointer to the full 16-byte UUID data.

methods.name: operator== (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Equality comparison between UUIDs.

methods.name: operator!= (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Inequality comparison between UUIDs.

methods.name: operator== (const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if UUID matches a short UUID.

methods.name: operator!= (const uint16_t shortUuid)
methods.description: Checks if UUID does not match a short UUID.

methods.name: operator< (const UUID& rhs)
methods.description: Less-than comparison for UUIDs.

methods.name: HasShort()
methods.description: Checks if UUID is a short UUID.

methods.name: Length()
methods.description: Returns length indicator of UUID (2 or 16).

methods.name: Data()
methods.description: Returns pointer to UUID data bytes.

methods.name: ToString(const bool full = false)
methods.description: Serializes UUID to string, full or short format.

methods.name: FromString(const string& uuidStr)
methods.description: Parses UUID from string representation.
